scientific_integrity: The theorem has a complete proof; the finite code is corroboration, not a substitute for infinite reasoning. Source priority remains an independent issue.
scientific_limitations: Classifies only (1,2)-overlap-free codes of length at least four. Prior maximum size is credited; no classification of arbitrary overlap intervals. Closest 2023 full paper unavailable and external priority unverified.
title: Rigidity and exceptional multiplicities of maximum two-overlap synchronization codes
